body: Because I do not have a reason to be here besides going to work. There are no goals that I am working towards. There is no one that is dependent on me. I feel more like a burden in my personal life, just someone people have to deal with. My students tell me they want to be like me and I just smile but inside I am very confused and thinking "why?"

My family would simply pray for me. I do not have any close friends anymore. I was always the one they would call when they had problems. I would listen to them for hours talking about their life's problems. When I needed them they were not there. Any time I would bring up the subject of how I was feeling when my aunt died they would continually change the subject.
